newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage rises 2.8 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage rises 2.8 pct in August.

text.p: The average net wage in Romania rose 2.8 percent in August from July, below the 3.8 percent monthly inflation rate, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Wednesday.
ROMANIAN AVERAGE WAGES AUG 96 JULY 96 AUG 95
NOTE: The CNS said purchasing power slipped by 1.0 percent in August from July but was 3.3 percent up year-on-year. It said August purchasing power was 73.1 percent of the 1990 level.
Employees in the banking sector had the highest average net wage of 659,122 lei in August, and workers in the health and social security sectors had the lowest -- 251,391 lei.
Romania employed 5.826 million people at end-August, 49,300 less than in July.
